voltage_levels.voltage_note: New 400 kV transmission station planned in conjunction with the Karlstadbenet 400 kV line program.

scope_description: New 400 kV transmission station Nya Borgvik in conjunction with the Karlstadbenet line program. Station solution not yet fixed; in investigation phase.

timeline.timeline_note: Karlstadbenet lines to be in operation by 2035; station commissioning aligned to that target.

contract.contract_note: Not yet in the procurement Gantt; too early in lifecycle.

narrative_note: Source explicitly notes 'Stationslösning ej fastlagen' (station solution not yet fixed). Karlstadbenet 400 kV line program is being designed by Svenska Kraftnät; Borgvik (existing transmission substation in subarea Värmland per Ellevio NUP §1.2) will be replaced or augmented by Nya Borgvik.
